name: Adventurer's Ring
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, common*

---

While the cover on this ring is open, the ring produces a flame that creates no heat and consumes no fuel. It sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 20 feet. As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can close the cover, smothering the flame, or open it again.

Lamps are a liability on adventures. Delicate and prone to oil spillage, lamps fill a hand that should otherwise be wielding a weapon or casting a spell. Once you try one of our elegant and practical rings, you'll never go back to cumbersome flint and fire.

name: Bright Fungal Cloak
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 4 lb | **Value:** 25 gp

---

While wearing a Bright Fungal Cloak, you can take a Bonus Action|XPHB to furl or unfurl it. When the cloak is unfurled, it sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 5 feet.

One pound of fungus is sewn into a Bright Fungal Cloak. This fungus can be eaten as food. Once all the fungus is consumed, the cloak becomes a mundane set of Traveler's Clothes.

*Never spelunk in the dark again! This cloak of bioluminescent fungus fibers is sure to brighten your day.*

name: Monster Camouflage
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 6 lb | **Value:** 50 gp

---

A suit of Monster Camouflage looks like a Beast or Monstrosity, such as an owlbear. To discern that you're disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation or Nature) check. The creature has Advantage|XPHB on this check if it is within 30 feet of you and automatically succeeds on this check if you do anything the monster you're disguised as couldn't do.

*The people of Icewind Dale have developed many strategies for safely traveling in dangerous wilderness. This outfit, adapted from hunting garb, deters strangers and animals alike.*

name: Thayan Spell Tattoo
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, uncommon (Requires Attunement)*

---

This magical tattoo contains the essence of a level 1-3 spell chosen by the tattoo's creator. While the tattoo is on your body, you always have the associated spell prepared, and you can cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spell uses your spellcasting ability; otherwise, if the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13 and the attack bonus is +5. If your Attunement|XPHB to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes.

You can also cast the spell once without a spell slot and spell components. Once the spell is cast in this way, the tattoo vanishes.

**Inking Thayan Spell Tattoos.** The Thayan art of magical tattooing is highly guarded by its practitioners, and thus, Thayan Spell Tattoos can't be crafted like other magic items. To learn how to ink Thayan Spell Tattoos, you must have a Renown Score of 50+ with the Red Wizards.

To ink a Thayan Spell Tattoo, you must have proficiency in the Arcana skill and with Calligrapher's Supplies and have the spell prepared each day of the inking. You must also have at hand any Material components required by the spell; if the spell consumes its Material components, they are consumed when you complete the tattoo. Inking a Thayan Spell Tattoo takes the same amount of time and money|XDMG|6|Time and Cost as scribing a Spell Scroll of an equivalent level.
